head.t: Olympus (KeyMed) wins £37k direct-award for Betsi Cadwaladr endoscopy scopes and drying cabinet
head.x: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board has directly awarded KeyMed (Medical & Industrial Equipment) Limited, Olympus's UK medical device business, a £37,015.66 contract for endoscopy scopes and stacks including a drying cabinet, for use at Wrexham Maelor Hospital.

head.t: Framework ending 30 September 2027: Endoscopy, Endourology and Oncology Ablation Consumables and Associated Products
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "KeyMed (Medical and Industrial Equipment) Ltd" (Lot 1, Lot 2). 58 suppliers on the framework.

head.t: Framework ending 31 July 2027: Digital Diagnostic Solutions
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "KeyMed (Medical and Industrial Equipment) Ltd". 54 suppliers on the framework.
